create_L1Loss: create an L1 loss module that computes mean weighted absolute difference between predictions and targets
create_L2Loss: create an L2 loss module that computes mean weighted squared difference between predictions and targets
create_CosineDistanceLoss: create a cosine distance loss module that computes negative mean weighted cosine similarity between predictions and targets
create_BCELoss: create a binary cross-entropy loss module that computes weighted BCE between predictions and targets
create_TripletLoss: create a triplet loss module with a margin that computes mean hinge loss from anchor, positive, and negative embeddings
